s: God loves Israel, but the priests offer blemished sacrifices. From the rising of the sun a pure offering will be made among the nations.
The priests have broken the covenant. God hates faithlessness in marriage.
God will send his messenger to prepare the way. Bring the full tithe to the storehouse.
The day of the Lord comes, and the sun of justice will rise. God will send Elijah before that day.

1: God foretells a pure offering among all nations from sunrise to sunset. The Church sees it fulfilled in the sacrifice of the Mass.
4: The last words of the Old Testament promise a messenger before the day of the Lord. Jesus says John the Baptist came in the spirit of Elijah.

3: In older English “meat” meant any food, not only flesh.
